src=open('convert_masks.py').read()
a=src.index('def parse_args():'); b=src.index('def parse_coords')
new='''def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Convert rectangle/polyline cell masks to polylines with MobileSAM."
    )
    names = ["weights_path", "output_path", "rgb_path", "csv_path"]
    helps = [
        "Path to MobileSAM weights (mobile_sam.pt).",
        "Output folder (or .csv file path) where the new masks are saved.",
        "Path to the RGB image.",
        "Path to the metadata csv.",
    ]
    # Accept both positional (in the order above) and --flag style arguments.
    for name, h in zip(names, helps):
        p.add_argument(f"pos_{name}", nargs="?", default=None, metavar=name, help=h)
    for name, h in zip(names, helps):
        p.add_argument(f"--{name}", f"--{name.replace('_', '-')}", dest=name,
                       type=str, default=None, help=h)
    args = p.parse_args()
    for name in names:
        if getattr(args, name) is None:
            setattr(args, name, getattr(args, f"pos_{name}"))
        if getattr(args, name) is None:
            p.error(f"missing required argument: {name}")
    return args


'''
open('convert_masks.py','w').write(src[:a]+new+src[b:])
EOF
